description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzVideoURLValidationAPI' which extends API endpoint functionality to validate video URLs, specifically for the Buzz plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It handles incoming requests to validate URLs, checks their validity, and returns validation results including embedded URL data.

classes.name: BuzzVideoURLValidationAPI
classes.description: A class providing API endpoint for validating video URLs within the Buzz plugin, including URL validation and response construction.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate a video URL, returning validation status and embedded URL info.

methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, primarily ensuring the 'url' parameter is present and a string.
